Kara L.: quick experiment proposal: add a tiny pricing estimator + collapse FAQ top fold. CTA should tie to the Sept webinar. Owen P.: primary metric = trial starts (7d). secondary = webinar RSVPs. also monitor /pricing bounce. Mina S.: two variants: V1 compact estimator with monthly/yearly + savings chip, V2 same but CTA nudges committed discount ("View committed savings"). Theo G.: routing rule: if estimator > $4k/mo tag lead "priority-inbound" and forward to SDR webhook. can implement via current lead webhook. Kara L.: micro-FAQ edits: turn longer answers into one-liners with "read more" links. target 35% fewer visible rows. Owen P.: success gates: +6% trial starts or +12% webinar CTR. run 2 weeks or until 1k estimator interactions. marketing-bot: staging snippet ready:
Mina S.: copy variants for estimator label: A) "Estimated monthly cost" B) "Starting monthly cost — refine". pick B to invite interaction. Theo G.: eng asks: lazy-load after hero, keep <50ms main-thread impact, idempotent API call, cache results per session. Kara L.: I'll draft experiment doc and runbook; Mina will post FAQ copy to #docs. Owen will own analysis. marketing-bot: staging deploy scheduled 2026-09-18T09:00Z. :rocket:
